pdb_path.description: Absolute path to the input PDB structure containing the protein backbone(s) and (optionally) heteroatoms/ligands that LigandMPNN conditions the sequence design on.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when omitted.

profile_guidance.description: Family-profile guidance compiled from a profile_source upstream. When the profile consensus length matches the LigandMPNN residue count, the adapter applies a soft position-specific amino-acid bias.

chains.description: Chain identifiers to design. Null designs every protein chain in the structure.

num_designs.description: Number of candidate sequences to sample.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0.1 (default) gives high-confidence sequences close to the model's argmax; raise toward 0.5-1.0 for diversity.

omit_aas.description: Amino-acid one-letter codes to forbid at every position. Default `X` blocks the unknown token. Concatenate letters with no separator.

seed.description: Optional RNG seed for reproducibility. Null lets the model choose its own seed.

model_type.description: Only `ligand_mpnn` is supported by this tool. It uses the bundled LigandMPNN checkpoint and conditions on heteroatoms when present.

redesigned_residues.description: Explicit structure residue IDs (space-separated, chain+number format) marking the designable positions. Use when `position_basis=structure` or when residue numbering is non-trivial.

redesigned_positions.description: FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions to redesign when `sequence` or `fasta_path` is provided. Positions are mapped onto the corresponding structure residue ids before MPNN runs.

sequence.description: Reference protein sequence for position mapping (paired with `redesigned_positions`). Null uses the sequence implied by the PDB.

fasta_path.description: FASTA file containing the reference sequence. Alternative to inline `sequence` for position mapping.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer positions in `redesigned_positions`. `auto` picks sequence when a reference sequence/fasta is given, else structure; `sequence` forces 1-indexed FASTA positions; `structure` forces legacy PDB residue numbering.
